component.name: SelfSteam
component.summary: Add Steam shortcuts with artwork from another device

description.p: SelfSteam is a headless companion that adds non-Steam shortcuts -- streaming services, RetroArch cores, and standalone emulators -- complete with SteamGridDB artwork, from a phone or another computer on the same network, while the target machine stays in Steam's Game Mode. A pairing code shown on screen is the only access control, no accounts needed.
Add a Custom tab to edit non-SelfSteam shortcuts (Target/Start In/Launch options), with SteamGridDB artwork search.
Show all non-Steam shortcuts, not just ones SelfSteam itself created.
Fix the pairing-code screen not appearing at all in gamescope sessions (missing DISPLAY in the sandbox).
Fix the pairing-code screen failing to launch under Flatpak.
